arxiv-2104-07419.title: TransRPPG: Remote Photoplethysmography Transformer for 3D Mask Face Presentation Attack Detection
arxiv-2104-07419.creator: Zitong Yu, Xiaobai Li, Pichao Wang, Guoying Zhao
arxiv-2104-07419.description: Abstract 3D mask face presentation attack detection (PAD) plays a vital role in securing face recognition systems from the emergent 3D mask attacks. Recently, remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) has been developed as an intrinsic liveness clue for 3D mask PAD without relying on the mask appearance.

arxiv-2201-04621.title: On partial uniqueness of complete non-compact Ricci flat metrics
arxiv-2201-04621.creator: Yuanqi Wang
arxiv-2201-04621.description: Abstract Using techniques for Caccioppoli inequality, on a fairly general class of complete non-compact Kähler manifolds with sub-quadratic volume growth, we show uniqueness of bounded C 1 , 1 C^{1,1} solution to Monge-Ampere equation. This does not a priori require any decay of the solution.

arxiv-2202-05997.title: Terahertz magneto-optical response in ferromagnetic Fe-Co-Al alloys Journal: J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
arxiv-2202-05997.creator: Sinisa Coh
arxiv-2202-05997.description: Abstract We study the magneto-optical properties of Fe-Co-Al ordered alloys in the terahertz range of frequencies. Using the standard Kubo-based approach to compute intrinsic part of the σ x ​ y ​ ( ω ) \sigma_{xy}(\omega) we find a strong dependence of σ x ​ y \sigma_{xy} on ω \omega in the terahertz range.

arxiv-2202-09034.title: Bounds on the smallest sets of quantum states with special quantum nonlocality
arxiv-2202-09034.creator: Mao-Sheng Li, Yan-Ling Wang
arxiv-2202-09034.description: Abstract An orthogonal set of states in multipartite systems is called to be strong quantum nonlocality if it is locally irreducible under every bipartition of the subsystems [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 122 , 040403 (2019) ]. In this work, we study a subclass of locally irreducible sets: the only possible orthogonality preserving measurement on each subsystems are trivial measurements.

arxiv-2206-11970.title: Learning quantum symmetries with interactive quantum-classical variational algorithms
arxiv-2206-11970.creator: Jonathan Z. Lu, Rodrigo Araiza Bravo, Kaiying Hou, Gebremedhin A. Dagnew, Susanne F. Yelin, Khadijeh Najafi
arxiv-2206-11970.description: Abstract A symmetry of a state | ψ ⟩ |\psi\rangle is a unitary operator of which | ψ ⟩ |\psi\rangle is an eigenvector. When | ψ ⟩ |\psi\rangle is an unknown state supplied by a black-box oracle, the state’s symmetries provide key physical insight into the quantum system; symmetries also boost many crucial quantum learning techniques.

arxiv-2210-11618.title: Multitasking Models are Robust to Structural Failure: A Neural Model for Bilingual Cognitive Reserve
arxiv-2210-11618.creator: Giannis DarasThe University of Texas at Austingiannisdaras@utexas.edu, Negin RaoofThe University of Texas at Austinneginraoof@gmail.comZoi GkalitsiouThe University of Texas at Austinzoi.gkalitsiou@austin.utexas.eduAlexandros G. DimakisThe University of Texas at Austindimakis@austin.utexas.edu
arxiv-2210-11618.description: Abstract We find a surprising connection between multitask learning and robustness to neuron failures. Our experiments show that bilingual language models retain higher performance under various neuron perturbations, such as random deletions, magnitude pruning and weight noise compared to equivalent monolingual ones.

arxiv-2301-00787.title: The Hamilton-Jacobi analysis for higher-order modified gravity
arxiv-2301-00787.creator: Alberto Escalante, Aldair Pantoja
arxiv-2301-00787.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alberto Escalante, Aldair Pantoja. The Hamilton-Jacobi [ H ​ J ] [HJ] study for the Chern-Simons [ C ​ S ] [CS] modification of general relativity [ G ​ R ] [GR] is performed. The complete structure of the Hamiltonians and the generalized brackets are reported, from these results the H ​ J HJ fundamental differential is constructed and the symmetries of the theory are found.

arxiv-2307-06589.title: Dynamical freezing and switching in periodically driven bilayer graphene
arxiv-2307-06589.creator: Soumya Sasidharan, Naveen Surendran
arxiv-2307-06589.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Soumya Sasidharan, Naveen Surendran. A class of integrable models, such as the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, respond nonmonotonically to a periodic drive with respect to the driving parameters and freezes almost absolutely for certain combinations of the latter. In this paper, we go beyond the two-band structure of the Ising-like models studied previously and ask whether such unusual nonmonotonic response and near-absolute freezing occur in integrable systems with a higher number of bands.

pmc-13545654.description: IgA nephropathy (IgAN) is a progressive glomerular disease marked by mesangial IgA deposition, inflammation, podocyte injury, and fibrogenesis. Although understanding of its pathophysiology has advanced, effective disease‐modifying therapies are still limited.
